page.layout: One printed page of running text, page number 174 at the head, catchword at the foot right. The facing page's right edge is visible at the far right as a cut-off strip and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: prio arbitratu, sed ab illius ecclesiæ, cui prospiciendum est, vel conjun-ctarum ecclesiarum presbyterio & magistratu fideli, atque assentiente populo sunt vocati, electi, & singuli certo cuidam gregi addicti. Idq; adhibito religioso timore, & præeunte accurato tum vitæ tum doctrinæ examine: ab illis, inquam, ecclesiis & cœtibus[?] electi & recepti; quos manifestis argumentis constat esse veras Christi ecclesias, quæq; eligendorum pastorum jus habent.

Officium illorum est erudire populum & gregem fidei suæ commissū, vel simpliciter scripturas interpretando (quod est doctorum in scholis proprium) vel etiam insuper singulariter illas tum publicè tum privatim ecclesiæ usibus applicando. Præterea impendunt operam administrandis sacramentis simulq; cum presbyteris disciplinæ ecclesiasticæ & cavendis offendiculis, quantum possunt, invigilant.

page.notes: Right margin: the facing page's text is cut off at the scan edge and largely unreadable, so it is not transcribed. Faint marks at the lower left and lower right of the text block (near "Pro") are show-through and were left out. "cœtibus" is a doubtful reading. The word "cæribus" in the scan is unclear.
